 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Start Node
 Start(( )):::startEndNode

 %% Farm Worker Swimlane
 subgraph Worker [\"Farm Worker\"]
 direction TB
 A[Submit Daily Activity Log]
 E[Review Correction Notice & Update]
 end

 %% System Swimlane
 subgraph Sys [\"System (Inventory & Logs)\"]
 direction TB
 B[Draft Pending Activity Record]
 F[Post Automated Stock Deductions]
 G[Write to Operations Logs Store]
 end

 %% Farm Manager Swimlane
 subgraph Manager [\"Farm Manager\"]
 direction TB
 C[Review Activity Draft]
 D{Is Submission\nValid?}
 end

 %% End Node
 EndNode((( ))):::startEndNode

 %% Workflow Routing
 Start --> A
 A --> B
 B --> C
 C --> D
 
 %% Decision Branches
 D -->|No: Rejected| E
 E --> A
 
 D -->|Yes: Approved| F
 F --> G
 G --> EndNode

 classDef startEndNode fill:#1e293b,stroke:#1e293b,stroke-width:2px,color:#ffffff,font-weight:bold;
 classDef decisionNode fill:#fef08a,stroke:#ca8a04,stroke-width:2px,color:#854d0e,font-weight:bold;
 
 class D decisionNode;",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
